part.text:
Fixed in `modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy/selectionpolicies.go` (CookieHashSelection.Select, ~line 837):

- Sticky cookie is now `SameSite: http.SameSiteNoneMode` always (previously `SameSiteDefaultMode`)
- `Secure` is now set to `true` when the request is over TLS or arrived via a trusted proxy with `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` (previously hardcoded `false` and even forced to `false` on TLS requests)

All reverseproxy tests pass, including `TestCookieHashPolicy`, `TestCookieHashPolicyWithSecureRequest`, and `TestCookieHashPolicyWithFirstFallback`.
